# NOW — the Chronicle

*Narrative only, regenerated by the engine from the page's records after every block (`saga.py record`); nothing here is edited by hand. Nothing from the real logs appears on this page except through the Reckoning.*

**BOOK II — THE TEMPERING ROAD · Chapter 7 — The Far Bank · the second night on the trail, late**

- **Where:** The river mill; the second fire, in a hollow under an oak on the north side of the walkers' road, about a day west of the river mill.
- **The quest:** *The Road.* North out of Coldmere by the mill tracks on Rae's cart, the quiet road, chosen for his own: keep the company out of the writs' reach and the hunt's. A rider sent to bring the captain of the Ninth in alive, and not told why, has found him anyway, and at the river mill where Rae's salt goes a dozen carts stand drawn up the wrong way at the bridge, everyone looking back.
- **What Darrow is fighting right now:** Two nights west on the walkers' road: the second night's fire, on the way back, and Rae's question.
- **Just happened (Between):** *Let It Talk.* Rae came round the fire, sat beside him and took his right hand; told to keep from Wren that he had told her first, she said Aye, and kept the hand.
- **Earlier today, in order:** *Worn Smooth* (Scene): Rae showed him her palms and told him of the cage and her father's splice, then asked why he does not go down on one knee at a stone and have it all back, when…
- **With him:** Maelis Vorne (Going north with the company and the forty; since *The North Side of the Trail*) · Ser Hollis Garrow (Captain of the forty on the road north; since *The North Side of the Trail*) · Wren Ashdown (On the road north with the column and the ledger; since *The North Side of the Trail*) · Rae Thorne (Beside Darrow on his side of the fire, his right hand in both of hers.) · Ash (At the second fire.)
- **Also here:** Ysra Tal (Got up off the ice on her own, took up her sword, said his message back to him word for word, named him Plainspoken, and rode into the alde…)
- **The tales:** Tale 1 — Where Not to Stand (told in full) · Tale 2 — Road's the Road (told in full) · Tale 3 — Two Boys Holding Horses (2 of 3 told)
- **Against him:** The road back to the river mill and the company's tracks north.
- **Next:** The third day: back east to the burned mill and after the company.
- **Open choice:** none.
